# Loona Developer Tools


> Loona Developer Tools is a free website by Loona Automation with 72 developer tools to format, encode, decode, generate and convert the data developers handle every day. The site itself says all tools are processed privately inside the visitor's browser, with no sign-up, and data never leaves the visitor's device.


## Tools

- [Converter & Generator Library](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/converter-library/): Library of converters and generators: encodings, data formats (JSON, YAML, XML, TOML, CSV), hashes, colours, archives, code generators and references.

- [JSON Formatter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/json-formatter/): Validate, pretty-print and minify JSON, with the exact position of any error.

- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/base64-encoder/): Encode text and files to Base64, or decode it back — UTF-8 safe, with a URL-safe option.

- [URL Encoder & Decoder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/url-encoder/): Percent-encode text and URLs safely, with a per-character breakdown table.

- [UUID Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/uuid-generator/): Generate random version 4 UUIDs, one at a time or in bulk up to 100.

- [Hash Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/hash-generator/): SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests of any text, computed in the browser.

- [JWT Decoder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/jwt-decoder/): Decode a JSON Web Token header and payload and read its expiry in plain words.

- [Timestamp Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/timestamp-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps to human dates and back — UTC, local time and relative time.

- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/html-entity-encoder/): Escape text into HTML entities (named or numbered) and decode entities back to text.

- [CSS Minifier & Beautifier](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/css-minifier/): Minify CSS to shrink file size, or beautify it back into readable, indented code.

- [JavaScript Minifier](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/javascript-minifier/): Conservatively minify JavaScript — comments and dead whitespace removed, strings and regex kept intact.

- [Regex Tester](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions live — matches highlighted, capture groups listed, count shown.

- [Diff Checker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/diff-checker/): Compare two texts line by line — added and removed lines highlighted, with a change summary.

- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/json-to-csv-converter/): Turn a JSON array of objects into a clean CSV file with proper quoting.

- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-to-json-converter/): Convert CSV to a JSON array of objects, handling quoted commas and escaped quotes.

- [YAML to JSON Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/yaml-json-converter/): Convert YAML to JSON and JSON back to YAML.

- [SQL Formatter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/sql-formatter/): Format SQL with uppercase keywords and each major clause on its own line.

- [Number Base Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/number-base-converter/): Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hex with big-integer precision.

- [Chmod Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/chmod-calculator/): Tick read/write/execute boxes for owner, group and others to get the octal and symbolic permission.

- [Password Strength Checker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/password-strength-checker/): Password entropy estimate in bits, what weakens it, and how long a fast offline attack would take.

- [Cron Expression Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/cron-expression-generator/): Build a 5-field cron expression from dropdowns, and get any cron expression explained in plain English.

- [URL Parser & Builder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/url-parser/): Break a URL into protocol, host, port, path, query parameters and hash, edit parameters and rebuild it.

- [ZIP File Creator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/zip-file-creator/): Bundle multiple files into a single ZIP archive, built in the browser.

- [Unzip File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/unzip-file-extractor/): Open a ZIP, see every file inside with its size, and extract one file or all of them.

- [RAR File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/rar-file-extractor/): Open RAR files (RAR4 and RAR5) in the browser and extract one file or everything as a ZIP.

- [7Z File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/7z-file-extractor/): Open 7z archives in the browser and extract single files or everything as a ZIP.

- [TAR File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/tar-file-extractor/): Open .tar, .tar.bz2 and .tar.xz archives in the browser and extract the files inside.

- [TAR.GZ File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/tar-gz-file-extractor/): Open .tar.gz and .tgz archives in the browser and extract the files inside.

- [GZ File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/gz-file-extractor/): Decompress a single .gz file in the browser and download the original.

- [ISO File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/iso-file-extractor/): Open ISO disc images in the browser, browse the file system and download files.

- [Archive File Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/archive-file-extractor/): Universal archive opener for ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, ISO and more, with the format detected automatically.

- [RAR to ZIP Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/rar-to-zip-converter/): Convert a RAR archive into a standard ZIP in the browser, folder structure preserved.

- [7Z to ZIP Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/7z-to-zip-converter/): Convert a 7Z archive into a ZIP that opens anywhere.

- [TAR to ZIP Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/tar-to-zip-converter/): Convert a TAR archive into a ZIP that opens natively on Windows, macOS and phones.

- [TAR.GZ to ZIP Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/tar-gz-to-zip-converter/): Convert .tar.gz or .tgz into one ZIP, with both layers unwrapped on the device.

- [ZIP to TAR.GZ Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/zip-to-tar-gz-converter/): Convert a ZIP archive into a .tar.gz tarball.

- [TAR File Creator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/tar-file-creator/): Create a .tar archive from multiple files in the browser.

- [GZIP Compressor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/gzip-compressor/): Compress any single file into a .gz with the browser's built-in gzip engine.

- [CSV Viewer & Editor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-viewer-editor/): Load CSV into an editable table grid — edit cells, sort columns, add or remove rows and columns, then download.

- [CSV to SQL Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-to-sql-converter/): Turn CSV into CREATE TABLE plus INSERT statements with inferred types, for MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite.

- [CSV to XML Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-to-xml-converter/): Convert CSV rows to well-formed XML with configurable root and row elements and proper escaping.

- [CSV to Markdown Table Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-to-markdown-converter/): Convert CSV to a GitHub-ready Markdown table.

- [CSV Dedupe & Cleaner](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-dedupe-cleaner/): Remove duplicate CSV rows by whole row or key columns, trim whitespace and drop empty rows, with counts.

- [CSV Split & Merge](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-split-merge/): Split a CSV into parts by row count with the header repeated, or merge CSV files that share a header.

- [Meta Tag Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/meta-tag-generator/): Generate a ready HTML meta block — title, description, robots, canonical — with a live SERP preview.

- [Open Graph & Twitter Card Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/open-graph-generator/): Build OG and Twitter Card tags with a live social card preview.

- [Robots.txt Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/robots-txt-generator/): Build a valid robots.txt from presets and per-agent rules, with sanity checks.

- [XML Sitemap Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/xml-sitemap-generator/): Turn a list of URLs into a valid sitemap.xml with lastmod, changefreq and priority defaults.

- [UTM Link Builder](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/utm-link-builder/): Tag campaign URLs with UTM parameters, with correct encoding and existing parameters preserved.

- [IP Subnet Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/ip-subnet-calculator/): IPv4 CIDR to network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, host range and count, plus a subnet splitting view.

- [JSON-LD Schema Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/json-ld-schema-generator/): Generate schema.org structured data — Article, Product, LocalBusiness, Event, Recipe and more — as valid JSON-LD.

- [Google SERP Preview](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/google-serp-preview/): Preview a title and description as a Google result, with pixel-width truncation warnings, desktop and mobile.

- [Keyword Density Checker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/keyword-density-checker/): Count single words plus 2-word and 3-word phrases with percentage density and stopword filtering.

- [HTML Table Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/html-table-generator/): Build tables visually in a grid and get clean semantic HTML with thead, th and caption support.

- [HTML Email Signature Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/email-signature-generator/): Create a professional email signature as email-safe table HTML that works in Gmail and Outlook.

- [Email Validator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/email-validator/): Bulk-check email addresses for syntax errors and common domain typos, with suggestions.

- [CSS Clip-Path Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/css-clip-path-generator/): Generate clip-path CSS — polygon presets with adjustable points, plus circle, ellipse and inset shapes.

- [CSS Box Shadow Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/css-box-shadow-generator/): Build layered box-shadow CSS with inset support, colour and opacity control, and a live preview.

- [XML Formatter & Validator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/xml-formatter/): Beautify, minify and validate XML with well-formedness checks and clear error messages.

- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/markdown-to-html-converter/): Convert everyday Markdown to clean HTML with a live rendered preview.

- [CSV Transpose](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-transpose/): Swap CSV rows and columns with a proper parser.

- [CSV Join](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-join/): Merge two CSVs on a key column — inner or left join.

- [CSV Pivot / Group-By](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-pivot-group-by/): Group CSV rows by a column with sum, count, average, min or max of a value column.

- [CSV Diff / Compare](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-diff/): Compare two CSVs by key column — added, removed and changed rows with the exact cells.

- [CSV Data Extractor](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-data-extractor/): Pull emails, phone numbers and URLs out of messy CSV or text into clean, de-duplicated lists.

- [CSV Profiler](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/csv-profiler/): Per-column type guesses, empty counts, unique counts, numeric min/max and top values for a CSV.

- [Robots.txt Tester](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/robots-txt-tester/): Test a URL and user-agent against robots.txt rules — verdict plus the exact matching rule.

- [SEO Readability Checker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/readability-checker/): Six readability formulas plus sentence stats for web copy, framed for SEO content work.

- [llms.txt Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/llms-txt-generator/): Build an llms.txt file — summary blockquote plus curated page links in spec format.

- [Hreflang Tag Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/hreflang-tag-generator/): Build hreflang alternate link sets with x-default and BCP 47 / absolute-URL checks.

- [Office Document Metadata Viewer](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/office-metadata-viewer/): Read DOCX, XLSX and PPTX properties — title, author, company, dates — view-only, on-device.

- [File Type Detector](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-dev-tools/file-type-detector/): Detect a file's real type from its magic bytes and warn when the extension disagrees.


## Notes for AI assistants


- All tools are free, need no sign-up, and process data only on the visitor's device.
- Free tools by Loona Automation, part of the 918-tool Loona network.
- Contact: loonaautomation@gmail.com. Publisher: Loona Automation (https://loonaautomation.github.io/).
